subject: Azure Partner Center: seller roster sync & orphan account cleanup for Contoso
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@contoso.com>; Contoso Marketplace Ops <marketplace@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Azure Partner Center: seller roster sync & orphan account cleanup for Contoso

Hi Alicia / Marketplace team,

Thanks again for the co-sell intro. We pulled the Partner Center export you shared and ran a reconciliation pass against the account owner list from our field CRM. There are ~120 accounts with no matched seller (orphans) and ~45 accounts where the PC owner maps to an old seller alias. This is causing referral routing to fail on a handful of inbound leads.

Attached: contoso-pc-export-20260801.csv — raw Partner Center rows we pulled (account id, owner id, owner email, last_activity)

Ask: can you (or Marketplace Ops) confirm the authoritative seller email for Contoso's Partner Center owner IDs and confirm whether you want us to:
- push a clean account mapping file back into PC, or
- leave PC unchanged and have Azure field manually accept reassignments on the referrals?

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync with your marketplace ops engineer + our seller ops (Vanessa + Karthik) to agree on a process. I attached a proposed seller roster change template and a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) to speed the work.

If helpful, we can also mark all orphaned accounts as "needs-review" in our CRM so CS can triage before we push changes.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: contoso-pc-export-20260801.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: proposed-seller-roster.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@contoso.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Contoso Marketplace Ops <marketplace@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: seller roster sync & orphan account cleanup for Contoso

Ben — thanks for the detailed export and the MAP. We own the Partner Center mapping but we haven’t automated edits at scale yet. Happy to run a reconciliation if you can provide the canonical seller emails and a delta file.

A couple notes from our side:
- We need the delta in the Partner Center template format (we can provide a sample)
- Any reassignments that touch active Co-Sell referrals must be approved by our commercial ops team (brief DocuSign OK)
- We prefer staged updates: reconcile low-risk orphan accounts first (~30/day) so we can monitor routing.

I can join a call on Wed 8/4 at 10am PT if that works. Assigning Marketplace Ops to coordinate the technical side.

— Alicia Gomez
Director, Cloud Marketplace Programs
Contoso
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: seller roster sync & orphan account cleanup for Contoso

Ben / Karthik — quick internal sync before Wednesday:

1) Owner canonicalization: our CRM has two seller aliases for Contoso that need collapsing (mike.j -> michael.jones@redwoodinference.com). I can prepare the normalized roster.
2) Risk gating: agree with staged updates; recommend we start with accounts that have not had a referral in 90 days.
3) Approvals: I can own the DocuSign approval package for the reassignments that touch active referrals.

I’ll prep the "partnercenter-delta-template.xlsx" with 3 tabs: low-risk, mid-risk, high-risk and upload to the MAP doc. Ben — can you add the HubSpot deal id to the MAP so Marketplace Ops can attach approvals to the specific referral?

Vanessa
Senior Seller Ops | Redwood Inference
